narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Measuring is enough, so there is no need to guess first.
<bookmark mark='read'/>Read the wrong scale on the wide angle, and the protractor shows fifteen degrees.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Only a quick guess tells you that such a wide angle cannot be that small.
